text:
Mina: quick mock + 45s loom of revised prereq step. focused on networking step + inline help. dropping link.
Marco: looked — nice. question: the "Retry probe" button placement is pretty close to the host copy. could we move it to the right?
Sam: agree, spacing feels tight on narrow windows. also when a probe fails we should surface potential fixes: header with 1-2 suggested actions.
Riley: accessibility: make sure the suggested actions are buttons (not plain links) so they are keyboard/touch friendly. add aria-describedby pointing to the failure summary.
Mina: Proposed microcopy for failure header: "Network probe failed — partial results shown." Suggested action buttons: "Retry probe" and "Show logs".
Marco: microcopy tweak: change "Retry probe" -> "Retry network probe" so it's explicit in multi-host lists.
Sam: also add small helper copy under logs: "Logs include TCP/SSH probes, traceroute, and port checks." small text needs 4.5:1 contrast.
Riley: color nit: current callout bg #fff3e0 is only 2.9:1 with body text. prefer #fff0d9 or use 12px bold for the label to pass contrast.
Mina: happy to update visuals. UX question: should "Show logs" open a panel or a full modal? I think panel inline so you keep context.
Marco: inline panel ok but ensure keyboard focus trap isn't used. panel should be dismissible with Esc and focus returns to the host row.
Sam: also add a compact summary row for collapsed hosts showing status pill + last probe time. clicking expands to full probe details.
Riley: screen reader flow: announce "Probe failed for host X" once when the panel opens using role=status and aria-live=polite. but avoid duplicate announcements when logs load.
Mina: noted. I'll update the mock: inline panel, action buttons, explicit copy, contrast fixes, and a persistent small toast for "Undo retry" when a retry is triggered.
Marco: question about the toast: should undo be available for retries triggered automatically by autoscan? PM preferred yes for user control.
Sam: if autoscan triggers retry, we should surface a lightweight toast with "Retry running  Undo" for 6s. if logs open, persist until closed.
Riley: also suggest keyboard shortcut hint in the panel footer: "Press R to retry" (only shown when panel focused). ensure shortcut doesn't conflict.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: build uploaded: prereq-inline-logs-panel at 2345678899
Mina: will push updated Figma + UX spec tonight. @Riley can you run a quick a11y checklist after PR? key items: role=status, aria-describedby on actions, focus return, contrast >=4.5, toast focus management.
Riley: yup. I'll validate with VoiceOver + NVDA and keyboard only. small follow-up: prefer descriptive link text for logs like "Show logs for host foo.example.com" so context isn't lost.
Sam: :thumbsup: good call. aiming to ship in the next private wizard patch.
